hints.title: Arrow-Formatted Path Obstacle
hints.text: Leaf paths require formatted string representations joined by arrows. How can appending each step along the descent construct the formatted path string directly upon reaching a leaf?

hints.title: Path String Accumulation Invariant
hints.text: Pass the current path string downward. When a leaf node is reached, append the formatted string to the answer list.

hints.title: Depth-First String Formatting Procedure
hints.text: If root is null, return empty list. Define a recursive helper with current node and current path string. If node has no children, append path string to result. Otherwise, recurse on left and right children if they exist, appending '->' and child value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Visiting all nodes and formatting strings along tree height H for up to N leaves.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating bottom-up path concatenations requires reversing and joining multiple sub-arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Formatting strings in-place or appending as children are discovered.
